LanguageData.VRE_FungalFlesh.description: Carriers of this gene have fungal matter in their flesh. Consuming any fungus by them is classed as cannibalism.
LanguageData.VRE_FungalFlesh.label: fungal flesh
LanguageData.VRE_Telepathy.description: Carriers of this gene can communicate with other carriers of this gene via psychic telepathy. Proximity is not required for social interactions.
LanguageData.VRE_Telepathy.label: telepathy
